subject: Pinecrest - Inference topology workshop: time options and prework
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: Pinecrest - Inference topology workshop: time options and prework

Hi Marta —

Great to meet during discovery last week. We'd like to schedule the technical workshop to walk through Pinecrest's inference topology, staging plans, and a short hands-on validation against a sample workload. Proposed goals:

- Surface expected production topology (multi-region / failover plan)
- Walkthrough of Redwood serving runtime choices and quantization options
- Run a short pre-recorded sample inference on your staging bucket (if available)
- Action items and rollforward plan (next 2–4 weeks)

Availability (all PT):
- Tue 17 May — 10:00–11:30
- Wed 18 May — 14:00–15:30
- Thu 19 May — 09:00–10:30 or 15:00–16:30

Could you confirm which slot works best and who from your side should join (security, procurement, infra)? If you need a longer window (90–120m) we can extend. I'm cc'ing Soojin (lead solutions engineer) and Ben (integration owner) — they’ll join the session.

Prework: attaching a short checklist (2 pages) — if you can share an approximate dataset size and whether staging credentials will be available that would help us prepare.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(redwood_pinecrest_workshop.ics attached as calendar stub)

Perfect — thanks for confirming Wed 18 May 14:00–15:30 PT (I’ll send a calendar invite now). We’ll reserve 90 minutes. Attached is the short prework checklist (pinecrest_prework_checklist.pdf) and a calendar stub (redwood_pinecrest_workshop.ics).

Soojin — can you lead the security/audit section (KMS, audit logs, retention) and keep ~20 minutes for Q&A? Ben — can you prepare a short demo of prefix/KV cache behavior with a ~1M token corpus example (we can run an abbreviated sample live if staging creds are available).

Thanks — sending the invite and an agenda in a follow-up email.
